name: design-fidelity
description: Visual design-fidelity loop: headless full-page screenshots (desktop+mobile) of every page a change touches, each read, after any change to a rendered page (the sst3-page-review hook prints the shoot command); live computed-CSS deltas and ImageMagick pixel-drift scoring to match a built site against a live reference. Read-only - it measures and suggests, never deploys.
